name: Supplemental Security Income (SSI)
description: Monthly payments from Social Security for people with disabilities and older adults who have little or no income or resources.
eligibility: Adults and children with little or no income, little or no resources, and a disability, blindness, or age 65+.
max_benefit: Depends on income, living situation and things you own
notes: Once on SSI, wages, other income and changes in resources or living arrangements must be reported each month.

name: Check eligibility for Social Security benefits
description: A short online questionnaire from Social Security that shows which benefits someone may qualify for and how to apply.
notes: It reflects the situation today and can't say whether someone will become eligible later.

name: Apply for SSI
description: Social Security's application page for SSI, with separate paths for adults (18 and over) and children (under 18).
eligibility: Adults or children with a disability or blindness and little or no income or assets.
how_to_apply: Online at ssa.gov/apply/ssi. The same page lets you return to a saved application and check application or appeal status.

name: Contact Social Security
description: Phone, video appointment, free interpreter services and local office locator.
how_to_apply: Call the National 800 Number or find a local office at ssa.gov/agency/contact.
notes: SSA says its website is the fastest way to get help.

name: Ticket to Work Help Line
administrator: Social Security Administration (Ticket to Work program)
description: Free help finding employment services and benefits counseling (WIPA) for people on SSI or SSDI who want to work.
eligibility: People who receive SSI or SSDI, ages 18 through 64, who want to work.
how_to_apply: 1-866-968-7842 (TTY 1-866-833-2967), or the Find Help tool at choosework.ssa.gov/findhelp.
